snippet.title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Your fight for survival begins on December 18th with 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor!

Trapped in the frozen wild after a crash, you have 28 days to gather, craft, and fight to stay alive. Every decision counts!
